N-th subsequent available symbol session CLOSE

research_config.universe_membership_note: research_universe.csv is a current-universe snapshot; it is not point-in-time historical membership. Results may be affected by survivorship bias.

market_regime.definition: 20-trading-day trailing NIFTY 50 return at the signal date

survivorship_sensitivity.method: For each horizon, rank symbols with valid signal outcomes by mean realized forward return; exclude the top ceil(10%) of symbols and recompute metrics.
survivorship_sensitivity.interpretation: Descriptive concentration stress test only. The ranking uses realized evaluation outcomes, so this is not an unbiased performance estimate and must not be used as a tradable rule.

random_baseline.interpretation: Compares selected stocks with random eligible stocks on the same dates while preserving the number of eligible signals per date. P-values are nominal and do not fully correct for overlapping outcomes, serial dependence, or multiple testing.

multiple_testing.family_scope: Valid horizon p-values within one research run and one evaluation stage.
limitations: Does not correct for separate research runs or strategy variants tried over time.
Does not repair invalid p-values or correct for temporal dependence and overlapping outcomes.
Statistical significance does not establish future profitability.

assumptions.sebi_rate_description: ₹10 per crore per side, modelled proportionally
assumptions.slippage_description: Assumed adverse execution-price movement on each side; not estimated from historical bid-ask data.

excluded_costs: Broker-specific deviations from the assumed schedule
